name: WorldTravel
abstract: WorldTravel evaluates multimodal travel-planning agents under tightly coupled real-world constraints. This page uses the Feasibility Rate from the multimodal setting.
method: This work frames travel planning as a tightly constrained agent task that requires multimodal information and real-world scheduling rules.
It focuses on feasibility rather than superficial answer quality, requiring plans to satisfy time slots, reservation constraints, dwell time, and opening windows.
The main results show that even leading models still achieve low feasible-plan rates in the multimodal setting.

metrics.name: Feasibility Rate
metrics.note: Feasible-plan rate in the multimodal setting.

leaderboard_note: The leaderboard uses the Feasibility Rate (%) from the multimodal setting and excludes the text-only setting.
